title: Shortest Substring Containing All Words
statement:
You are given a sentence `S1` made of `n` words and a list `S2` of `m` words. Find the **shortest contiguous part of `S1`** (a run of consecutive words) that contains every word that appears in `S2`.

- Words are compared exactly and are case sensitive; here they consist of lowercase letters.
- `S2` may repeat a word. Only which words occur matters: a repeated word still needs to appear just once in the part you pick.
- The length of a part is its number of words. If several parts have the minimum length, choose the one that starts **earliest** in `S1`.
- Every word of `S2` is guaranteed to appear somewhere in `S1`.

Print the chosen part: its words in their original order, separated by single spaces.
inputFormat:
The first line contains the integer `n`, followed by `n` words (the words of `S1`) separated by whitespace.
Then come the integer `m` and `m` words (the words of `S2`), separated by whitespace.
outputFormat: Print the words of the shortest part on one line, separated by single spaces.
constraints: Each word has 1 to 10 lowercase letters
Every word of S2 appears in S1

hints: Trying every start and extending to the right until all words are covered is O(n^2) in the worst case. Use two pointers instead.
Move the right end forward, keeping a count of how many times each required word is inside the window and how many distinct required words are covered.
Whenever every required word is covered, record the window and then shrink it from the left as long as it stays valid, since a shorter window might still work.

        fmt('this is a test string for test purposes'.split(), ['test', 'string', 'purposes']),

        fmt('x y x y y x'.split(), ['y', 'x', 'y', 'x']),
